paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Gurya. R. Avin bar Huna, in his name. Gurya bar Chama—perhaps his son. Rav Huna said: R. Chama bar Gurya said: Rav said—Shabbat 139b. R. Chisda said in his name: Menachot 78a. “R. Chelbo said: R. Chama bar Gurya said: Rav said”—Megillah 18b, 19a; Kirah, 37a. R. Chelbo, in R. Chama bar Ukva's name, in R. Yosi bar Chanina's name; see there. R. Minyomi bar Chilkiyah, in his name; see Nachman bar Gurya. “Rav said”; see above. Shabbat, chapter 1, 9a, several laws; Eruvin 26a, 46b, 60a. There, 49b: “Rabbah said: R. Chama bar Gurya said: Rav said.” I think “Rabbah said” is a scribal error, or it should read “bar Yirmeyah.” Moed Katan 12a, near the end; Yevamot 45b; Avodah Zarah 16b. “Rava bar Mechasya said: R. Chama bar Gurya said: Rav said”—Shabbat 10b, several statements. Rabbah bar Rav Huna called him “our teachers”; see Mari bar Mar. “Rabbah bar Yirmeyah said: R. Chama bar Gurya said”—Avodah Zarah 16b; see above. He objected to Shmuel: Bava Kamma 99b.
